facts.fact: Banco Nacional de Angola Instrutivo n.º 02/2025 of 13 August 2025, issued under article 6 of Lei n.º 40/20 of 16 December 2020 (Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos), sets value limits for cheques, Multicaixa network transactions, ATM withdrawals and card transfers and purchases for supervised financial institutions.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola (Lei n.º 40/20)

systems.tiers: financial institutions supervised by the Banco Nacional de Angola
